# ”Bolidens förvärv ligger verkligen rätt i tiden”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this EFN Morgon episode the hosts go through macro risk: Japanese 10-year yields have reached 3%, Brent oil is at $91.50 amid Hormuz tensions, and September has historically been the weakest month for stocks. Shein fell 10% on its Hong Kong debut, which the hosts think is fairly good news for H&M, and MediaTek jumped after Nvidia invested in it. The main Nordic view is that Boliden's zinc acquisition is well timed because zinc prices are rising, and BioArctic got a positive note after Canada approved subsidies for Leqembi. Overall the mood is cautious, and the Stockholm exchange was expected to open slightly lower.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 BOL — Boliden | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Zinc prices are rising sharply on supply disruptions, and the host says Boliden's zinc acquisition is well timed.

#### Reasoning

Host Gabriel Malmqvist connects the Bloomberg report on rising zinc prices, driven by technical mine stoppages, to Boliden's large zinc acquisition. Most commentators questioned the deal, but if it completes and zinc stays high, Boliden benefits. This is conditional and focused on the commodity, not an explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the zinc acquisition does not go through
- if zinc prices fall back as mine supply recovers

> *"Om affären blir av och zinkpriserna fortsätter vara pressade på hög nivå så är det här bra för Boliden. Förvärvet ligger verkligen rätt i tiden."*

---

### 🟠 HM-B — H&M | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host thinks Shein's weak IPO is fairly good for H&M because it shows the low-price model is not sustainable.

#### Reasoning

The hosts see Shein's falling valuation and slowing growth as evidence that the ultra-low-price model is losing momentum, which could ease price pressure on H&M. This is a tentative view ('jag tror... kanske'), not a trade call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Shein regains growth momentum
- if price pressure from Chinese e-commerce increases

> *"Jag tror att en lite dålig start för Shein kanske ändå är ganska bra för H&amp."*

---

### 🟠 SHOT — Scandic Hotels | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Record numbers of tourists visited Stockholm this summer. Scandic has come up several times as a winner from this trend.

#### Reasoning

Stockholm's chamber of commerce reports record guest nights. The host notes Scandic has been named as a beneficiary and wonders whether this is also a stock-market trend. This is a speculative observation, not a recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the tourism trend reverses
- if the consumer/macro backdrop weakens

> *"Jag tycker att Scandic Hotel har kommit upp i Börslunch flera gånger de senaste veckorna som en vinnare på den här trenden."*
